blocks.text: Multi-channel sales outreach across email, LinkedIn, and calls

lemlist takes a multi-channel approach to outbound sales. Instead of relying solely on cold email, it orchestrates sequences across email, LinkedIn, and phone - reaching prospects where they are most likely to respond.

The AI personalization features go beyond simple merge tags. lemlist can generate custom icebreakers based on prospect data, create personalized images with dynamic text overlays, and adjust messaging based on engagement signals. This level of personalization at scale produces response rates that generic templates cannot match.
The built-in lead database and LinkedIn automation eliminate the need for separate prospecting tools. Find prospects, verify their emails, and launch multi-channel sequences from a single platform.
Email, LinkedIn, and phone steps in unified workflows
AI-generated icebreakers and dynamic personalized images
Built-in B2B prospect database with email verification
Automated LinkedIn visits, connections, and messages
Automated sender reputation building for cold email
Two-way sync with Salesforce, HubSpot, and Pipedrive
Multi-channel outreach consistently produces better results than single-channel. lemlist makes it manageable by orchestrating email, LinkedIn, and phone touchpoints in a single sequence.
Our team can integrate lemlist into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
